metadata.description: Hand-curated pathognomonic and disease-defining markers for clinical vignette reasoning
metadata.lr_scale_note: LR+ >= 100 = pathognomonic (virtually diagnostic); LR+ 20-80 = highly specific but not pathognomonic
metadata.compatible_diseases_note: v1.1 (16.9 P0): 'compatible_diseases' lists non-defining diseases where the marker is KNOWN to occur. The reverse-exclusion signal is SUPPRESSED for these to avoid false ruling-out (e.g. JAK2 V617F vs ET/PMF). Exclusion strength is now graded by confidence (pathognomonic=0.1, highly_specific=0.3) instead of a fixed 0.15.

markers.note: BCR::ABL1 fusion defines CML; present in >95% of CML cases. Also a defining entity in 'AML with BCR::ABL1' (WHO 2022) and seen in Ph+ ALL — do NOT use to exclude those.
p210 isoform strongly associated with CML; p190 more common in Ph+ ALL. Molecular confirmation of BCR::ABL1.

markers.source: WHO Classification of Haematolymphoid Tumours 2022; Hematology textbooks
markers.note: Auer rods are crystallized azurophilic granules found exclusively in myeloid lineage blasts. Pathognomonic for AML (especially abundant as 'faggot cells' in APL).
Binucleated or multinucleated giant cells with prominent eosinophilic nucleoli (owl-eye appearance). Defining feature of classical Hodgkin lymphoma. CD15+/CD30+.

Fragile CLL lymphocytes that rupture during blood smear preparation. Highly suggestive but not pathognomonic; can be seen in other lymphoproliferative disorders. >55% smudge cells strongly suggests CLL.
PML::RARA fusion is the defining genetic event of APL. Present in virtually all APL cases. Critical for diagnosis as APL requires urgent ATRA therapy.
MYC translocation (usually t(8;14), less commonly t(2;8) or t(8;22)) is required for diagnosis of Burkitt lymphoma. Present in virtually 100% of cases.
JAK2 V617F is present in ~95% of PV cases (major diagnostic criterion). Also seen in ET (~55%) and PMF (~65%), but combined with erythrocytosis it is virtually diagnostic of PV.
t(14;18) is present in ~85% of follicular lymphoma cases. Also found in ~20-30% of DLBCL (GCB subtype). In context of low-grade B-cell lymphoma with follicular pattern, highly specific.
t(11;14) with cyclin D1 overexpression is the hallmark of MCL, present in >95% of cases. Rare CCND1-negative MCL exists with CCND2/CCND3 rearrangements.
Hemoglobin S results from Glu6Val mutation in beta-globin. Homozygous HbS (HbSS) defines sickle cell disease. Hemoglobin electrophoresis showing predominant HbS is diagnostic.
Anti-dsDNA antibodies are highly specific (~95%) for SLE but sensitivity is ~60-70%. Titers correlate with disease activity, especially lupus nephritis. Specificity >95% but not pathognomonic.
Anti-CCP has ~95% specificity and ~60-70% sensitivity for RA. More specific than RF. Strong predictor of erosive disease. Can precede clinical RA by years.
c-ANCA/PR3-ANCA is found in ~90% of active generalized GPA. Specificity ~95% for GPA among vasculitides. Titer may correlate with disease activity.
AMA (especially M2 subtype targeting pyruvate dehydrogenase complex) is present in ~95% of PBC. Specificity >95%. In context of cholestatic liver disease, virtually diagnostic.
ASMA (particularly anti-F-actin) present in ~70% of type 1 AIH. Specificity ~80% in context of hepatitis. Less specific than AMA for PBC; requires clinical correlation.
IgA EMA has ~99% specificity for celiac disease. Combined with anti-tTG IgA, can be diagnostic without biopsy in children (ESPGHAN criteria). Near-pathognomonic specificity.
Birbeck granules (pentalaminar rod-shaped organelles seen on electron microscopy) are pathognomonic for Langerhans cells. CD1a and langerin (CD207) immunohistochemistry now preferred over EM.

terms: apple green birefringence under polarized light
markers.source: ISA (International Society of Amyloidosis) consensus guidelines
markers.note: Apple-green birefringence under polarized light after Congo red staining is pathognomonic for amyloid deposits. Gold standard for tissue diagnosis of any amyloidosis subtype.
Large basophilic intranuclear inclusions with perinuclear clearing (owl-eye appearance) in enlarged (cytomegalic) cells are pathognomonic for CMV infection on tissue biopsy.

markers.source: §22.3; Endocrinology textbooks; van Beek et al. Eur J Endocrinol 2004 (glucagonoma syndrome review)
markers.note: Necrolytic migratory erythema is the characteristic dermatosis of glucagonoma syndrome (present in the large majority of symptomatic cases), classically with new-onset diabetes/hyperglycaemia and weight loss. Near-diagnostic in that triad; rarely mimicked by severe zinc/essential-fatty-acid deficiency.

markers.source: §22.3; WHO Haematolymphoid Tumours 2022; clinical hematology references
markers.note: Persistent absolute basophilia is a hallmark of CML and the BCR::ABL1-negative MPNs, and is uncommon in reactive leukocytoses or AML — useful to favour a myeloproliferative process over a reactive or acute-leukaemia explanation of a very high WBC. Do NOT use to exclude the compatible MPNs.

Anabolic-androgenic steroid use (esp. 17-α-alkylated; bodybuilders) is a recognised cause of peliosis hepatis / hepatic sinusoidal dilatation, which can rupture → acute haemorrhagic shock. AAS also predisposes to Budd-Chiari, hepatic adenoma and HCC (compatible_diseases) — discriminate by presentation (acute haemorrhage/blood-filled cavities = peliosis; hepatic-vein outflow obstruction + ascites = Budd-Chiari).

markers.source: §23.13; Detterbeck FC, Pancoast (superior sulcus) tumors review; thoracic oncology references
markers.note: An apical (superior sulcus) tumour invading the lower brachial plexus (C8-T1) produces fixed, NON-positional arm/hand weakness + sensory loss + burning shoulder/medial-arm pain, classically with Horner syndrome (ptosis/miosis/anhidrosis) in a smoker. The Horner + lower-plexus + apical-mass combination strongly favours Pancoast over positional/vascular causes (scalenus anticus, subclavian steal) and over a primary plexopathy. Used to surface the apical-tumour entity under a 'compressive plexopathy' domain (§23.14 anatomy axis); do NOT use to exclude the compatible_diseases.
